# UNBOUND

> UNBOUND is an outsourced marketing department: a fractional CMO, brand, product marketing, growth hacking, PR, social, SEO/SEM and lead engine, content, sales enablement, website and media strategy, with AI in the workflow. One team and one story across every channel a brand touches.

UNBOUND was founded by Amisha Sethi and Himani Sharma, and is based in India. Brands work with UNBOUND through a monthly brand partnership or a fixed-scope campaign or launch. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute brand session with both founders, followed by a written plan with the price within three working days.

## Services

- Growth strategy and growth hacking: positioning, go-to-market, channel planning, and weekly experiments that grow social following, brand visibility and sign-ups.
- PR and reputation: media relations, press launches, founder profiling, crisis communication, reputation management.
- Social media: strategy, content and reels, creators and influencers, community management, paid social.
- SEO/SEM and lead engine: technical SEO, SEM, lead engine creation and management, traffic management.
- Content marketing: e-books, journals, guides, product collateral, blogs and newsletters.
- Sales enablement: brochures, flyers, presentations, sales kits, case studies.
- Website development and optimisation: builds, speed and SEO health, conversion optimisation, landing pages.
- Media strategy: channel mix, budgets and timing across digital, print, outdoor and broadcast.
- Creative and design: campaign ideas, design and video, brand identity, templates.
- Tech-savvy: AI integrated into research, content, media and reporting. Monthly report delivered as a PPT deck.
